purpose: A light dial laid out around sub-dial positions for complications. It draws nothing from the complication registry yet; the positions are geometry, not a promise.

night.recipe: The dial background and the ticks flip with the palette; the hands and sub-dials keep their own colours.

options.intent: One colour for every sub-dial accent; the sub-dials are siblings, not a hierarchy.

antiPatterns.rule: Do not present the sub-dial positions as configurable complication slots
antiPatterns.why: the face reads no slot today; D2 says wire complications, never fake them
